description: This file defines the LeaveDuration class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It represents different types of leave durations (full day, half day, specify time) and includes logic for handling leave times, validation, and type-related queries.

classes.name: LeaveDuration
classes.description: Represents the duration of a leave, including type (full day, half day, specify time) and optional start/end times. Contains validation and helper methods for leave duration logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeaveDuration instance with specified type and optional start/end times.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of leave duration.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets and validates the leave duration type.

methods.name: getFromTime
methods.description: Returns the start time if applicable; restricts call for invalid types.

methods.name: setFromTime
methods.description: Sets the start time when applicable.

methods.name: getToTime
methods.description: Returns the end time if applicable.

methods.name: setToTime
methods.description: Sets the end time and validates it against the start time.

methods.name: restrictCallConditionally
methods.description: Ensures methods are called only when the duration type permits.

methods.name: isTypeFullDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is a full day.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is a half day (morning or afternoon).

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayMorning
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is a half day in the morning.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayAfternoon
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is in the afternoon.

methods.name: isTypeSpecifyTime
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration is specified for certain times.
